thread:
nisha: Heads-up — AB run for v3-int4 (shadow->quiet-burn) shows a localized degradation on the `technical-doc` slice. Putting eval dashboard link in thread.

jordan: link? quick numbers pls

metric-bot: AB summary: delta Rouge-L -3.2% (CI95), embedding cosine -0.012 (p=0.03), latency p95 +18ms. sample n=720 over 6h. full report: https://evals.redwood/reports/1749654321

nisha: This exceeds our promotion smoke thresholds for quiet promote. Proposal: immediate rollout backstop — block increase beyond 1% traffic and do not promote to 10% until slice-concordance recovers.

sam: Can we codify auto-fallback thresholds? My suggestion: trigger rollback if ANY of: delta Rouge-L <= -1.0% OR embedding cosine <= -0.005 OR latency p95 > +25ms (vs baseline). Also require min sample n>=500 in last 6h to avoid noisy flips.

lee: We already have a 1h cooldown window after a rollback. Question: should the backstop cut traffic immediately but keep shadowing on for diagnostics, or fully cut both?

jordan: Prefer immediate traffic cut (stop routing). Keep shadowing for 24h so we can reproduce and capture diffs. Also require statistical significance check (p<0.05) before auto-cut to avoid flapping.

nisha: Agree. Drafting the rollout backstop policy now. Proposed config snippet:
```
{
  "target_variant":"v3-int4",
  "slices":["technical-doc","api-examples"],
  "min_sample":500,
  "window_h":6,
  "thresholds":{
    "rouge_delta": -0.01,
    "embed_cosine": -0.005,
    "latency_p95_ms": 25
  },
  "actions":{
    "on_trigger":["cut_traffic","continue_shadow_24h","notify_oncall"],
    "cooldown_minutes":60,
    "fallback_variant":"quant8"
  }
}
```

deploy-bot: config diff uploaded: `/configs/rollout/backstop-v3-int4.json` (PR #7612)

sam: Quick ask — include a soft-fail path: if quant8 exists, route affected traffic to `quant8` at 50% while we investigate, otherwise cut to 0% and keep shadowing.

lee: +1 for variant mapping and weighted-stepping. Also add a brief TTL to auto-rollforward attempts (e.g., only try fallback for 3h then revert to off unless manual ack).

nisha: I'll add those details and run a controlled canary (0.5% -> 2% with slice-weighting) with manual approval gates. If the backstop fires I'll kick off a short postmortem and surface top failing prompts. @jordan can you own oncall in that window?

jordan: Oncall ack, I’ll watch the alert channel and paging. :thumbsup:

eva-bot: Alert rule created: `eval.alerts.rollout-backstop.v3-int4` — thresholds set, notification to #eng-oncall and #eng-ml.

nisha: Thanks team — will post PR diff and timeline in 30m. If anyone sees urgent evidence of offline regressions DM me.
